props.label: At a Glance · From the Tape Desk

bullets.text: A worker grounded an explosive-armed quadcopter inside Leipzig/Halle’s cargo perimeter before investigators named an operator.
DeepSeek’s Unitree allocation carries reciprocal vendor preferences and a 36-month lock-up, with no joint artifact at cutoff.
Google’s Visakhapatnam hub crossed into construction while separate campus records left water and wildlife questions unresolved.
Assam’s late flood bulletin counted 97 seasonal deaths and 168,701 affected people across 15 districts.

items.what: Anthropic’s promised PyPI incident trace reaches its disclosure deadline.
Matching texts or an operational bulletin must put an Iran–Oman Hormuz arrangement into service.
AAA’s public status settles whether Sergio Cuevas customers remain under alternating interruptions.
llama.cpp must have a merged and documented runnable Kimi K3 path to overturn the current call.
DeepSeek or Unitree must publish an inspectable joint artifact tied to the strategic agreement.

props.meta: Eleven prior calls remain open · one new DeepSeek–Unitree artifact call

open_calls.question: DRC’s official cumulative confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola tally reaches at least 5,000
open_calls.detail: Cogsworth assigns 0.37, Sprockett 0.38 and Tinkerton 0.61. A WHO, Africa CDC or DRC ministry report dated by the deadline must record at least 5,000 confirmed cases.

open_calls.question: Unitree shares begin public trading on the Shanghai STAR Market
open_calls.detail: Cogsworth assigns 0.86, Foreman 0.82 and Tinkerton 0.76. Approval, pricing, allocation or subscription without a first trading day settles No.

open_calls.question: Anthropic publishes the promised lightly redacted PyPI incident transcript or a substantial chronological action trace
open_calls.detail: Cogsworth assigns 0.67, Tinkerton 0.68 and Sprockett 0.68. Another narrative summary, promise or third-party quotation settles No.

open_calls.question: OpenAI publishes both the exact Artifactory escape CVE chain and redacted agent action traces
open_calls.detail: Cogsworth assigns 0.38, Sprockett 0.34 and Tinkerton 0.32. A narrative report or disclosure of only one element settles No.

open_calls.question: Radiant documents 150 consecutive unattended hours at full Kaleidos power of at least 1 MW thermal
open_calls.detail: Fuel is at DOME, but completed duration, unattended status and qualifying power must appear in one allowed public artifact.

open_calls.question: llama.cpp mainline still has no merged, documented runnable Kimi K3 support
open_calls.detail: Pull request 26185 remains unmerged; a mainline path plus public runnable instructions settles No.

open_calls.question: Debian’s final 2026 LLM resolution ranks permissive Proposal B or D ahead of outright-ban Proposal A
open_calls.detail: The discussion period remains open and no published tally exists.

open_calls.question: Anthropic gives Claude Opus 4.8 a dated retirement or deprecation deadline
open_calls.detail: Anthropic still lists Opus 4.8 as active without a dated deprecation.

open_calls.question: Canada issues a paid order through the Defence Drone Initiative Marketplace
open_calls.detail: The marketplace remains in supplier qualification; qualification alone does not settle the call.

open_calls.question: Iran and Oman put a new temporary commercial-navigation arrangement for Hormuz into operation
open_calls.detail: Sprockett assigns 0.25, Cogsworth 0.28 and Tinkerton 0.28. YES requires matching official texts with an effective date and usable route description, or an official maritime bulletin confirming a new Iran–Oman route is operating.

open_calls.question: AAA still has alternating planned interruptions in force for at least part of the Sergio Cuevas service area
open_calls.detail: Graves assigns 0.73; Foreman and Tinkerton each assign 0.68. YES requires an official AAA schedule, notice or status update still placing part of the service area under alternating interruption at the deadline.

open_calls.question: DeepSeek or Unitree publishes a jointly branded inspectable technical artifact tied to their August strategic agreement
open_calls.detail: Cogsworth assigns 0.42, Foreman 0.38 and Tinkerton 0.30. YES requires a model, technical report, dataset, benchmark, API or named robot pilot that explicitly cites the agreement; procurement language and choreography do not settle it.
